text: Tchoukou is the Hausa and Fulani name, tikomart the Tamasheq. One process was found across all villages surveyed around Zinder. The same sun-drying is used for Klila in Morocco, Gapal in Burkina Faso and Gashi in Mali (Seini et al. 2018).

steps.name: prepare rennet
steps.note: Dried calf rennet steeped in water with ginger, hot pepper, garlic or onion, Guinea pepper, and millet and cowpea grain.
In the open air, on mats of Deverra scoparia stalks.
